Continuous Security 

Constantly reduce the likelihood and impact of cyber-attack. Sygnia MDR, powered by the Velocity TDIR platform, provides complete visibility into your environments and continuous and fast threat detection, investigation and response. 

Purpose-built by incident responders, Velocity TDIR platform collects, processes and queries vast amounts of data, providing speed and efficiency in threat hunting, threat detection, forensic investigation to support the MDR team, which in turn feeds intelligence to enhance detection and analysis capabilities. 

This ensures fewer successful attacks, reduced dwell time and fewer material incidents.
